guard.note: the loop whose renderer lookup is redirected (null = not translucent, then continue)
getRenderer: player model-name map, else the EntityType map; also re-checked after other mods' mixins (Guards.untouched)
reload replaces both renderer maps with new immutable maps

cofh_translucent_renderer_memo.conversion: @Redirect of the getRenderer call in CoFH's ITranslucentRenderer.renderTranslucent + @Accessor of the player renderer map (probe mixin, priority 100000)
